sources.title: Robust Lightweight Deep Learning Models for Oral Cancer Screening
sources.snippet: II-ARetrospective Data A retrospective dataset was used to develop, tune, and evaluate the AI models. To ensure a robust evaluation of model generalisability, the cleaned dataset was partitioned into a training set for model optimisation, a validation set for checkpointing, and a strictly held-out test set for final performance benchmarking.
